declarations.docstring: States that a projective resolution of a module exists.
Shows that a module has a projective resolution with free underlying modules in every degree.
Provides a basis for the underlying module of the associated module object.
Assigns a module object to each module.
The underlying module of the associated module object is free.
The associated module object is projective.
The morphism from the associated module object to the given module.
The morphism from the associated module object is an epimorphism.
Assigns a projective resolution to a module.
Every degree of this projective resolution has a free underlying module.
Constructs a morphism from the image of the kernel under over to the source of a morphism.
Composing the kernel lift with the given morphism yields zero.
The short complex made from the kernel lift and the given morphism is exact.
Constructs a projective resolution from a projective epimorphic family.
Builds a chain complex from an endofunction, a family of morphisms, and an object.
Identifies the differential from degree one to degree zero in the constructed complex.
The constructed complex is exact at every positive successor degree.
Every term of the constructed projective resolution is equal to over applied to some object.
Every degree of the constructed complex is projective.
